tldr: Admins can now export all family data as 1 ZIP file. A background job writes 4 CSV files and 1 NDJSON file and attaches the ZIP to a FamilyExport record.
goal: Let a family take a full copy of its data out of Maybe.

story.heading: Family::DataExporter added
story.body: It writes accounts, transactions, trades and categories as CSV, plus all.ndjson, into 1 ZIP.

story.heading: Settings now starts an export
story.body: The controller creates a FamilyExport and queues FamilyDataExportJob. The request returns at once.

story.heading: The job builds and attaches the ZIP
story.body: Status moves to processing, then completed. On an error the job sets failed.

story.heading: FamilyExport added
story.body: A new family_exports table stores the status. Family has many exports. The ZIP is an Active Storage file.

story.heading: Download goes through the controller
story.body: download sends the stored file only when the export is completed and attached.

story.heading: Settings lists the last 10 exports
story.body: A Turbo frame shows the list. It refreshes every 3 seconds while an export runs.

components.summary: Settings shows an Export data button and a list of exports that refreshes while one runs.
New FamilyExportsController: admins start an export, list the last 10 and download a completed one.
New FamilyDataExportJob builds the ZIP, attaches it and sets the export status.
Family has many exports. New Family::DataExporter writes 4 CSV files and all.ndjson into 1 ZIP.
New FamilyExport model with a status and an attached file. It belongs to a Family.

decisions.title: Build the archive in a background job
decisions.why: A full export reads every account and transaction. The request returns at once and the UI polls for the result.
decisions.alternative: Build and stream the ZIP inside the request.

decisions.title: Exporter in the Family:: namespace
decisions.why: The app keeps domain logic in model namespaces. Family::DataExporter follows that convention.

decisions.title: A FamilyExport record holds the state
decisions.why: The list, the polling and the download read 1 status. The file is an Active Storage attachment on the record.
decisions.alternative: Keep the state only in the job queue.

decisions.title: CSV per entity plus 1 NDJSON dump
decisions.why: CSV opens in a spreadsheet. NDJSON keeps each record with its nested data, such as the accountable of an account.
